question: Why are Iran's airlines being shut out of the Gulf?

lines.text: The UAE has suspended every flight by Iranian airlines, until further notice.
The reason: US sanctions on Iran's aviation.
Washington sanctioned 36 aviation targets this month.
The US Treasury Secretary: you cannot provide them with fuel. You cannot provide them with landing services.

scene.quote: you cannot provide them with fuel

lines.text: Iraq and Oman have stopped Iranian flights too.
Iran's Mohsen Rezaei warned: their airports will not be able to operate either.

scene.quote: their airports will not be able to operate either

lines.text: Iran, cut off from the sky. Who blinks first?
